description:
Three large Tiffany & Co. Florentine serving pieces an elaborate, classical appearance. Their ornate handles feature layered borders and pointed decorative tips, complemented by a pierced serving surface, a shell-shaped spoon bowl, and a triangular server with a serrated edge.
The three Tiffany pieces include a cake or pie server, a broad pierced server, and a shell-shaped serving spoon. The photographed Tiffany marking reads “Tiffany & Co.,” “Sterling,” and “Pat. 1900.” Florentine was introduced in 1900; the patent marking refers to the pattern rather than establishing these pieces’ manufacture date.
Also included are three assorted sterling silver spoons in differing designs, including one with a sharply curved handle. These smaller pieces are not Tiffany.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.

Flat-Rate Shipping

cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

description:
Cast Brass Double Inkstand
Brass Double Inkwell Desk Stand with Pen Tray
Renaissance Revival Style, Late 19th to Early 20th Century
This ornate cast brass desk inkstand exemplifies the historicist decorative motifs of late 19th-century Renaissance Revival design. The composition features an arched openwork pediment with winged cherubs flanking a central crest, set above two inkwells and an integrated pen tray centered with a bearded Green Man grotesque mask. Complete with its two removable brass ink cups and domed finial lids, it combines functional writing utility with ornate sculptural presence.
Heavy cast brass construction weighing 3.6 lbs with authentic sand-cast underside
Complete 5-piece assembly including desk stand, two brass well cups, and two domed lids
Detailed casting with winged cherubs, scrolling side handles, and a Green Man motif
Measures approximately 10 inches wide by 7 inches deep and 4.5 inches high
Condition:
Very good vintage condition with intact structural integrity and all original components present. Shows an attractive natural brass patina with light oxidation and surface darkening in recessed areas consistent with age. No cracks, breaks, or repairs observed; sits level on its feet.

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight.
Shipping:
All items are typically shipped within five business days (Monday through Friday, excluding major holidays) following the date of purchase. We do NOT offer any shipping options faster than FedEx Ground.
Please contact us prior to making payment if there are specific shipping requirements or requests such as signature confirmation or insurance.
Additional charges may apply.
We do not, under any circumstances, accept pre-paid shipping labels provided by customers.
Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.
Combined Shipping:
Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item.
Local pickup
is available on
select items only
, and will be noted on the item as "Local Pickup". Pickup items are available at the Goodwill of Colorado Springs Main Campus, located at 1460 Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs, CO, 80907.
For qualifying pick-up orders, pickup is available by appointment only.
Delivery Not Received:
Please contact within 7 days of the expected delivery date if a package has not been delivered by the time provided by the shipping carrier. We will file a claim with the shipping carrier (typically FedEx) after that. Please do not file a claim before contacting us, FedEx requires the shipper to file them. If the item is returned to us because a signature could not be obtained, or if an item is returned to us as undeliverable/unclaimed it is the buyers responsibility to contact us within 7 days and pay the additional postage to mail it again otherwise items returned to us will be considered a donation and relisted at our discretion.
We are not responsible for packages that were delivered and stolen from property. Goodwill will not be liable and all refund requests will be denied.
Damaged Merchandise:
If merchandise has been damaged during shipping, please contact us within 7 days. Photos of packaging and item damages will be required for refund approval.

Description:
Discover a beautiful assortment of natural geode mineral specimens, perfect for both collectors and enthusiasts. This lot features six unique geodes, including striking purple amethyst and sparkling quartz varieties, each showcasing its own raw crystalline structure and captivating color palette. The visible mix of purple, white, and gray hues offers both elegance and organic charm, ideal for display in any home, office, or educational setting. Each geode presents differences in size and texture, creating a visually engaging collection where no two pieces are exactly alike. Their mineral surfaces catch the light, highlighting the natural sparkle inherent in amethyst and quartz. These geodes are suitable as decorative accents, teaching aids for geology, or thoughtful gifts for crystal lovers and rock collectors alike. All items are in good used condition, with some natural rough edges and minor imperfections typical of unpolished minerals. Enjoy adding this diverse set of geodes to your collection or gifting them to someone who appreciates the raw beauty of geological wonders

shipping.policy:
1.We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
2. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
3. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
4. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.
6.
Can not combine Buy Now Items (due to system limitations)

7. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
8. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

Ideal for both collectors and those interested in geology or lapidary arts, this set lends itself to educational exploration, decor, or gift giving. Each stone and arrowhead is individually separated in the organizer, making it easy to view and access each piece. The stones appear to be in good condition, with minor visible wear on some surfaces. Whether for display, study, or creative inspiration, this unique crystal and arrowhead set would make a meaningful addition to any collection
